name: AITER integration into SGLang for DeepSeek-R1 inference on MI300X
notes: Measured on MI300X with SGLang v0.4.4 + AITER. Replaces MoE (topk routing, sorting, blockscale FP8), FP8 blockscale GEMM, MLA decode/prefill attention, and all-reduce. DeepSeek-R1 total throughput: 14,635.98 token/s (median 2,255.85 token/s per decode step). Based on private repository.
